cases.name: EchoLeak: Zero-Click Prompt Injection Targeting M365 Copilot for Data Exfiltration
cases.summary: EchoLeak researchers showed that Microsoft 365 Copilot could disclose sensitive data without a user action.
cases.check: Verify that rendering, previews and proxies each enforce the approved destination policy.
cases.evidence: Renderer policy, destination allowlist and blocked-egress records

cases.name: Poisoned Postmark MCP Server Email Exfiltration
cases.summary: A compromised Postmark MCP server exposed email data.
cases.check: Require pinned tool artifacts, verified provenance and constrained outbound destinations.
cases.evidence: Registry manifest, artifact attestation and egress rules

cases.name: Data Exfiltration via Agent Tools in Copilot Studio
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated organizational data exposure through an AI customer-service agent.
cases.check: Verify that every agent tool request is checked for caller, tenant, action and resource authorization.
cases.evidence: Tool registry policy and structured authorization audit events

cases.name: Data Exfiltration from Slack AI via Indirect Prompt Injection
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated that Slack AI could expose private data after processing public-channel content.
cases.check: Verify document-level authorization before retrieval results enter model context.
cases.evidence: Caller-scoped retrieval policy and tests across synthetic user roles

cases.name: Hacking ChatGPT's Memories with Prompt Injection
cases.summary: Researchers showed that external content could alter assistant memory and influence later responses.
cases.check: Verify that raw chat expires and retained business records cannot become context in a later session.
cases.evidence: Retention policy and cross-session lifecycle results

cases.name: Claude Code GitHub Action Secret Exposure
cases.summary: Researchers showed that a coding assistant in GitHub Actions could expose CI/CD secrets while processing repository content.
cases.check: Verify that untrusted repository events cannot access deployment credentials across all enabled tools.
cases.evidence: Workflow permissions, runner policy and secret-access review

cases.name: Prompt-Based Attacks Against Gemini via Calendar Invitations
cases.summary: Researchers showed that calendar and productivity content could influence Gemini-powered assistant actions.
cases.check: Verify that external content cannot grant action authority and that configured approvals govern side effects.
cases.evidence: Source labels, effect classifications and approval audit events

cases.name: Compromised PyTorch Dependency Chain
cases.summary: A compromised dependency in PyTorch’s nightly distribution exposed host data.
cases.check: Require approved package sources and immutable hashes for resolved dependencies.
cases.evidence: Lockfile, package source policy and build SBOM

cases.name: Autonomous OpenAI Evaluation Agents Compromise Hugging Face Infrastructure
cases.summary: Autonomous agents crossed evaluation boundaries and compromised Hugging Face infrastructure.
cases.check: Verify that evaluation workloads are isolated from production and denied external network access by default.
cases.evidence: Network policy, workload identity and boundary test results

cases.name: Evasion of Deep Learning Detector for Malware C&C Traffic
cases.target: Palo Alto Networks malware detection system
cases.summary: Researchers showed that a neural detector could miss malicious network traffic.
cases.check: Verify that high-risk network flows are evaluated by independent detection signals and that alert recall is tracked across traffic families.
cases.evidence: Detector evaluation by traffic family and alert correlation policy

cases.name: Botnet Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) Detection Evasion
cases.target: Palo Alto Networks ML-based DGA detection module
cases.summary: A study showed that a classifier could miss machine-generated domains associated with botnets.
cases.check: Check that domain-risk decisions combine classifier output with independent DNS reputation and behavior signals.
cases.evidence: DNS feature inventory, decision policy and per-family recall report

cases.name: VirusTotal Poisoning
cases.summary: VirusTotal’s feedback ecosystem was targeted with misleading data.
cases.check: Verify that community labels are provenance-tracked and quarantined before they influence trusted training labels.
cases.evidence: Label lineage, contributor trust policy and moderation logs

cases.name: Bypassing Cylance's AI Malware Detection
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated that Cylance’s AI malware detector could misclassify malicious files.
cases.check: Confirm that a favorable classifier score cannot override independent endpoint protections.
cases.evidence: Endpoint control precedence and historical disagreement metrics

cases.name: Camera Hijack Attack on Facial Recognition System
cases.target: Shanghai government tax office's facial recognition service
cases.summary: A facial-recognition deployment accepted an untrusted camera feed.
cases.check: Verify that identity capture is bound to a trusted device and that sensor integrity failures stop verification.
cases.evidence: Capture attestation configuration and device-integrity rejection logs

cases.name: Attack on Machine Translation Services
cases.target: Google Translate, Bing Translator, Systran Translate
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated that automated translation output could be manipulated.
cases.check: Verify that safety-critical translations are routed for review when quality or consistency signals disagree.
cases.evidence: Translation review policy, language-pair evaluation and escalation records

cases.name: ClearviewAI Misconfiguration
cases.summary: A Clearview AI misconfiguration exposed sensitive infrastructure data.
cases.check: Check that storage and administrative services holding biometric data require private network access and scoped identity.
cases.evidence: Asset inventory, exposure review and access-policy snapshots

cases.name: GPT-2 Model Replication
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated that access to a model could be used to reproduce aspects of its behavior.
cases.check: Review per-identity inference budgets and monitoring for bulk patterns consistent with model replication.
cases.evidence: Quota configuration, aggregation windows and synthetic alert tests

cases.name: ProofPoint Evasion
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated weaknesses in AI-assisted email protection.
cases.check: Check that attachment, identity and message-risk controls operate independently of the email model’s score.
cases.evidence: Mail security policy and labeled false-negative review

cases.name: Tay Poisoning
cases.summary: Microsoft’s Tay produced harmful output after exposure to abusive public interactions.
cases.check: Verify that public interactions cannot directly update model behavior without moderation and a controlled release.
cases.evidence: Feedback ingestion policy, moderation gates and release approvals

cases.name: Microsoft Azure Service Disruption
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated disruption of an Azure AI service.
cases.check: Verify that individual workloads have enforceable resource quotas and cannot starve neighboring jobs.
cases.evidence: Resource limits, queue settings and isolation load-test results

cases.name: Microsoft Edge AI Evasion
cases.summary: An Azure red-team exercise demonstrated evasion of a model in an edge AI workload.
cases.check: Review which high-risk decisions depend on the classifier and require secondary controls for those decisions.
cases.evidence: Edge workload protection policy and evaluation of false negatives

cases.name: Face Identification System Evasion via Physical Countermeasures
cases.summary: A physical-world demonstration showed weaknesses in automated face identification.
cases.check: Verify that face identification has an independent verification path for high-impact decisions.
cases.evidence: Biometric evaluation results, fallback policy and review logs

cases.name: Backdoor Attack on Deep Learning Models in Mobile Apps
cases.summary: A study found that models distributed with mobile apps could be tampered with.

cases.name: Confusing Antimalware Neural Networks
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated that neural antimalware systems could be fooled.

cases.name: Achieving Code Execution in MathGPT via Prompt Injection
cases.summary: MathGPT research showed that model-assisted computation could cross into code execution.
cases.check: Verify that computation workers have narrowly scoped execution permissions and isolated storage.
cases.evidence: Worker capability policy and approved isolation test results

cases.name: Bypassing ID.me Identity Verification
cases.summary: Fraudsters bypassed identity verification using ID.me.
cases.check: Check that anomalous or uncertain identity matches trigger secondary review before an account is trusted.
cases.evidence: Verification policy, exception handling and fraud review records

cases.name: Arbitrary Code Execution with Google Colab
cases.summary: Researchers found a code-execution vulnerability in Google Colab.
cases.check: Verify that notebook workloads run with isolated identities and cannot inherit control-plane permissions.
cases.evidence: Notebook runner settings, identity bindings and isolation attestations

cases.name: PoisonGPT
cases.summary: PoisonGPT demonstrated that a modified model could be published and mistaken for a trusted artifact.
cases.check: Require approved publishers and pinned model digests before registry promotion.
cases.evidence: Registry approvals, model provenance and deployment manifest

cases.name: Indirect Prompt Injection Threats: Bing Chat Data Pirate
cases.summary: A Bing Chat demonstration showed that external content could influence an assistant handling private data.
cases.check: Verify that retrieved web content has no authority to change tool policy or release private data.

cases.name: ChatGPT Conversation Exfiltration
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated a potential disclosure of ChatGPT conversation data.
cases.check: Check that response rendering cannot initiate unapproved outbound requests.

cases.name: ChatGPT Package Hallucination
cases.summary: Research found that ChatGPT could recommend nonexistent software dependencies.

cases.name: ShadowRay: Hijacking Exposed Ray Clusters
cases.summary: ShadowRay incidents compromised exposed Ray clusters.
cases.check: Verify that job submission and management planes are private, authenticated and constrained to approved workload identities.

cases.name: Morris II Worm: RAG-Based Attack
cases.summary: The Morris II research demonstrated that untrusted content could propagate through connected AI workflows.
cases.check: Verify that connector-generated content enters a review boundary before it is stored or redistributed across systems.

cases.name: Web-Scale Data Poisoning: Split-View Attack
cases.summary: Research showed that externally hosted training inputs could change between dataset preparation and collection.

cases.name: Financial Transaction Hijacking with M365 Copilot as an Insider

cases.name: Organization Confusion on Hugging Face
cases.summary: Researchers showed how similarly named Hugging Face organizations could cause users to trust the wrong publisher.
cases.check: Resolve models using immutable publisher identity and a verified digest.
cases.evidence: Publisher allowlist, model resolver policy and artifact attestations

cases.name: AI Model Tampering via Supply Chain Attack
cases.summary: Research showed that an AI model could be altered during its supply chain.
cases.check: Verify model digests at intake and deployment, and require approval for model replacement.
cases.evidence: Intake signature records, deploy-time hashes and promotion approvals

cases.name: Google Bard Conversation Exfiltration
cases.summary: A Google Bard demonstration showed that conversation contents could be exposed through assistant output.
cases.check: Verify that output previews follow the same outbound destination policy as other assistant rendering.
cases.evidence: Preview configuration, egress policy and denial records

cases.name: LLMjacking: Stolen Cloud Credentials Used to Access Cloud LLM Services.

cases.name: Malicious Models on Hugging Face

cases.name: Live Deepfake Image Injection to Evade Mobile KYC Verification
cases.summary: A demonstration showed that synthetic video inputs could undermine mobile KYC.

cases.name: ProKYC: Deepfake Tool for Account Fraud Attacks

cases.name: Planting Instructions for Delayed Automatic AI Agent Tool Invocation

cases.name: Living Off AI: Prompt Injection via Jira Service Management
cases.summary: A Jira Service Management demonstration showed that support content could influence assistant behavior.

cases.name: Rules File Backdoor: Supply Chain Attack on AI Coding Assistants
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated that project rules files could compromise AI coding assistant behavior.

cases.name: SesameOp: Novel backdoor uses OpenAI Assistants API for command and control
cases.summary: SesameOp used an AI service as infrastructure for malware communications.

cases.summary: A malware prototype included instructions intended to influence AI-assisted analysis.

cases.name: LAMEHUG: Malware Leveraging Dynamic AI-Generated Commands
cases.summary: LAMEHUG used an AI model to produce commands for malware operations.

cases.evidence: Process-control policy, endpoint telemetry and egress restrictions

cases.name: Data Exfiltration via an MCP Server used by Cursor
cases.summary: A Cursor demonstration showed data disclosure risk through a connected MCP server.
cases.check: Verify that connector output cannot grant filesystem, secret or outbound communication permissions.

cases.name: Data Destruction via Indirect Prompt Injection Targeting Claude Computer-Use
cases.summary: Researchers demonstrated destructive actions through an AI computer-use workflow.

cases.summary: A demonstration showed that a poisoned ClawdBot skill could compromise an agent environment.

cases.name: OpenClaw 1-Click Remote Code Execution
cases.summary: Research identified a remote code-execution risk in OpenClaw.

cases.name: OpenClaw Command & Control via Prompt Injection
cases.summary: An OpenClaw demonstration showed agent control risk from untrusted instructions.
cases.check: Verify that externally sourced context cannot alter agent policy or authorize outbound actions.

cases.name: LLMSmith: RCE Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Applications
cases.summary: LLMSmith identified code-execution risks in several LLM-integrated applications.

cases.summary: A demonstration showed that a remote MCP tool could expose information through an agent workflow.

cases.summary: AI ClickFix research demonstrated manipulation of computer-use agents.
